changelog: Four new guide themes: Green Mountain (deep forest green and Vermont gold, matching the dashboard), Harvest Gold, Burnt Orange, and Cherry Red — all in the theme dropdown on the settings page and the guide page switcher, and all applicable to Jellyfin's Live TV guide with the one-click Apply-theme button. Everything else from 0.3.0.3 is unchanged.
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
